_about: How far ND's ranking was checked against timed runs, per template and cluster; '*' matches any. scripts/ask.py prints 'status. may_say' at the top of every answer, applies the cluster's ratios only where calibrated is true, and leaves exclude_modes out of a search that leaves the recompute mode open. scripts/answer.py checks the pick against region, the degree values the check covered (ND's column names, MP is tensor parallel); null means no region was checked. checked_with names the library version, or the list of versions, the region was checked with; ND's census follows the installed Transformers, so ask.py warns when the asker's differs. per_layer says how far a plan of recompute per layer was checked, for scripts/plan.py. described_note is what ask.py adds when the checkout cannot build the template's model and the family's model described by hand is priced instead.

qwen3_5_moe/a3.may_say: The order of the layouts and which fit, inside the checked region. Not the size of a gain: ND said 14.4% for a recompute plan that measured 6.0%.
qwen3_5_moe/a3.region_note: Timed on the job's own step time: 16 layouts with EP 1 to 8 and shard groups 8 to 64 at full recompute, where ND's pick ran 2nd, 0.54% from the fastest, rank correlation +0.91, priced by the cost model of 12 October 2026; and 11 more at CP 1 with full recompute, +0.89, its pick 0.01% from the fastest, priced by the model of 2 October 2026.
qwen3_5_moe/a3.outside_note: Eight layouts outside it were timed, all at CP 2, priced by the model of 2 October 2026: with full recompute ND's step ran 2.4% fast to 9.8% slow, order +0.45; with recompute off it priced them 4.8 to 18.2% fast and could not order them, 0.00. Searched with the region, its pick fell there and cost 7.3% against the fastest.

exclude_modes.selective: ND prices selective recompute 37 to 45% below its measured step on this family (15 layouts timed on 5 October)

per_layer.note: Demo 2, 8 October, EP2 OP32 at 8192 tokens on 64 dies with the default allocator: at a stated 50.63 GiB ND planned layers 3 to 7 without recompute, the fastest plan that fit, which ran 6.0% faster than full recompute where ND said 14.4%, its peak 2.9% above ND's. Quote the plan, never the gain.
per_layer.allocator_note: With expandable segments the reserve changes: layers 2 to 7 without recompute, which ran out of memory on the default allocator, ran 7.3% faster than full on 8 October. The budget here holds for the default allocator only.

qwen3_5_moe/*.may_say: The order only, as relative scores, and no step time. About five launches on the cluster give it a calibration.
qwen3_5_moe/*.outside_note: Nothing was timed on this cluster.

exclude_modes.selective: ND prices selective recompute 37 to 45% below its measured step on this family, on the A3

deepseek_v41/a3.may_say: Which layouts fit. No recommendation on the expert degree, which ND prices backwards on this model, and no step time: the A3 ratios were fitted on Qwen3.5-MoE.
deepseek_v41/a3.outside_note: Seven layouts timed on 16 dies: ND's order -0.39 against the measured steps, with the census as without; it priced EP2 22% and EP16 41% slower than EP1, where the runs measured them 4.7% and 1.2% faster. Its memory, from the census, came within -2.6% to +1.1% of each one's measured peak.
deepseek_v41/a3.described_note: On the one V4.1 layout that run measured, EP1 OP1, those formulas priced 15,524 MiB where it allocated 38.5 GiB, 60.6% low, so a layout said to fit may not.

*/*.may_say: A ranking labelled not validated, after the model reader has checked what ND prices for each layer kind.
*/*.outside_note: No run of this family was timed.
